name: PokéMart
purpose: Instagram-style Pokémon card storefront: a mobile-first visual feed of cards, tap to inspect, Turbo add-to-cart with a live counter, and guest checkout with a signed expiring receipt link.
actors: Guest shopper (browse and buy without an account)

entities.name: Order
relationships: captures email, status, signed receipt token

workflows.name: Browse card feed
workflows.description: Public root shows a scrollable visual grid of cards with prices

workflows.name: Inspect card
workflows.description: Tap a card to open detail in a Turbo frame — image, set, rarity, price

workflows.name: Add to cart
workflows.description: Add to cart from feed or detail; cart counter updates without a full reload

workflows.name: Guest checkout
workflows.description: Enter an email, complete via local test simulator, receive a signed expiring receipt link

workflows.name: View receipt
workflows.description: Open order receipt via signed token link; signed-in owners see their own orders

seed_demo: 18-24 real Pokémon cards across rarities (Double Rare, Ultra Rare, Special Illustration Rare, Mega Hyper Rare, Rare) with real market USD prices and official card images, e.g. Mega Charizard X ex, Umbreon ex, Gengar ex, Team Rocket's Mewtwo ex.
